I also found a concrete resource leak in its frame buffer: replacing a frame at the same timestamp leaves the old GPU frame open, and frames arriving after shutdown can remain retained. I’ll repair those disposal paths while keeping the larger playback requirement open.

ISSUE-1591 has a concrete transaction-lifetime bug: migration waits for a cloud write while holding an IndexedDB cursor, then tries to continue that cursor after the transaction may have closed. It also silently discards upload failures.

The two existing structural contract tests, lint, and renderer typecheck pass. Real multi-record migration and reload verification remain open.
